channel.title: Open Meadow Games — Development Log
channel.description: Behind the scenes at Open Meadow Games. Game design decisions, art updates, and stories from the development of Park & Hide.

item.title: The Fishing Reel
item.description: Fishing has a reel now: scroll the mouse wheel toward you to bring the fish in.

item.title: The Teacup House
item.description: A closer look at the teacup house in Fairy Hollow, and the cat asleep on its saucer.

item.title: The Toadstool House
item.description: A closer look at the toadstool house in Fairy Hollow.

item.title: Fairy Hollow in Pine Forest
item.description: I added a small clearing to Pine Forest with six little houses in it.

item.title: An RV Park at the Coastal Cliffs
item.description: I made the Coastal Cliffs map bigger so it could fit a small RV park.

item.title: The Van and the Workbench
item.description: Crafting happens at a workbench now, and I redrew the inside of the van.

item.title: Fall at the Rest Stop
item.description: There's a park with a pond you can fish in now, and you can go inside Lee's garage.

item.title: Making the Ocean Move
item.description: I made the ocean at the Coastal Cliffs move.

item.title: Ricardo's Shelter Has a Home
item.description: Ricardo and his dog shelter are at the Rest Stop now.

item.title: Pixel Art & NPC Animation Milestone
item.description: I replaced the ground tiles, and the beaches are animated now.

item.title: Open Meadow Games is Official
item.description: Open Meadow Games is officially a studio now, and Park & Hide is its first game.
